psychological_meaning: Dark blue often represents stability, depth, and expertise. It evokes feelings of trust, loyalty, wisdom, confidence, intelligence, faith, truth, and heaven. It is associated with the sky and sea, symbolizing vastness and tranquility, but also authority and importance.
